gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-noto-sans-old-south-: Bruno Ace draws every curve and straight with the same ruled line, rigid and a little futuristic. Noto Sans Old South Arabian, a plain sans, loosens that up, its curved strokes easing out before they turn inward.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ojuju: Expressive lettering leads here, Bruno Ace holding every stem and curve to one line with no hairlines at all. Ojuju then adds a faint crayon-like flicker.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-pt-sans: PT Sans keeps its c forms open like gentle arcs, a plain sans that stays friendly under Bruno Ace's ruler-drawn headings. Paragraphs of it flow easily.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-roboto-flex: Distinctive from the first glance, Bruno Ace keeps its counters open to the outside and never shifts from hairline to stem. Roboto Flex, a plain sans with a wide slot in each c, is the friendly counterweight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-rosario: Contemporary and a bit stubborn, Bruno Ace gives its bowls as much weight as its stems. And Rosario, a sans whose c ends never curl inward, softens the whole layout beside it.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-sarabun: Hard-edged and ruler-straight, Bruno Ace has no thin hairline anywhere, just thick, lingering letters, one beat each. Sarabun, a plain sans, opens a wide channel into every bowl.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-stick: Rigid tubes of letters, Bruno Ace lingers on each character while counters stay open to the outside. Stick, a plain sans with constant-weight lines, lets light pass through its wide exits.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-tasa-explorer: Bruno Ace is all ruled lines. TASA Explorer, a plain sans, ends its curves like brush strokes lifted early, so Bruno Ace supplies the rigid, expressive display punch while the body adds a softer touch.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-teachers: Bruno Ace sets a ruler-drawn, constant-width line that lingers on every character. Teachers, a sans-serif of thin bent steel, tapers its ink strokes out before touching, so paragraphs move with a light, modern touch.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-telex: Telex is curvy and loose. Bruno Ace, drawn with no thick-thin flicker, makes the headings rigid, while this sans keeps long paragraphs feeling unclamped and relaxed to read.
